name: xenon
description: Shows this Claude Code session on the Xenon dashboard: subagent models, live context and quota, messages typed on the Claude tile arriving here, a status line under the prompt, a /xenon connection check, and optional approvals from the dashboard.

band.title: Xenon status line
band.description: Under the prompt, say when Xenon is not reachable or not linked, or an approval is waiting on the dashboard. Nothing is shown while all is well.

inbox.title: Messages from the Xenon tile
inbox.description: While this session is idle, a message typed for it on the Claude tile in Xenon arrives here as if you typed it. Off: the tile continues the session in the background instead.

approvals.title: Approve from the Xenon dashboard
approvals.description: Permission requests also appear on the Xenon dashboard. With no answer there, the terminal asks as usual.

approvalWaitSec.title: Seconds to wait for the dashboard
approvalWaitSec.description: How long a permission request waits on the dashboard before the terminal asks (10 to 120).
